title: XDRIP not able to communicate with MiaoMiao
symptom: After leaving the phone to charge and being away from the MiaoMiao for about an hour, xDrip could not communicate with the MiaoMiao to get Libre readings.
fix: The thread does not provide a definitive fix. A user suggests workarounds: enable GPS, go to scan bluetooth and click again on the MM2, disable and re-enable Bluetooth and press 'restart collector', and check the state when away from the collector.
evidence_quote: What I do is to enable GPS, go to scan bluetooth and click again in the MM2. Sometimes I need to disable an re-enable the BT and press "restart collector".
